flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Furnish/{form/DecisionForm,form/ReplyComposeForm,form/ReplyEmail,form/ReplySMS,form/ComposeList,components/SelectTemplate,components/ComposeEditor,hooks/useFurnishAPI}, pages/Notice/{form/Form,hook/useNoticeSubmit}, utils/mapping/Furnish/FurnishMap. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsTemplateStore (templatestorelist, templatestore/render), workflows/furnish/manualreview/{controllers/ManualReviewController,services/ManualReviewService} (send-email, send-sms), workflows/furnish/helpers/FurnishNotificationService. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used for the officer reply
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); no separate requirement is given, steps are taken from the story text. The compose flow in the Staff Portal is complete: ticking Send Email/SMS opens the Reply tab, the officer picks mode and recipient, picks a FURNISH_* template, the rendered result lands in subject/body fields that stay editable, then the entry goes into the compose list. Two gaps: (1) template content is a DB row (ocms_template_store) that is not seeded in the repo, so its presence in PRD cannot be verified from the repo; (2) the Email CC field is sent by the UI but dropped by the backend. Real delivery over SMTP and the SMS APIM cannot be proven from the repo. The demo remark (Enable cron, Internet-Intranet sync) is not a step because it is not in the story text; its effect (notice shows in eService) is covered in OCMS41.20.
recommendation: Claim the template selection and free-text edit flow. Fix or record the dropped Email CC gap, and prepare evidence of the FURNISH_* template rows in the PRD database (screenshot or DB script) because the repo cannot prove them

steps.step: Officer ticks Send Email/SMS on the furnish decision so the Reply tab opens
steps.detail: The Send Email/SMS checkbox (source sendEmailSms) appears in the OIC Review panel while the furnish status is not yet Approved/Rejected (DecisionForm.tsx:435, 472-479). Form.tsx:88-90 computes showReplyTab from sendEmailSms === "true", and Form.tsx:240-246 shows the Reply tab (ReplyComposeForm) only in UPDATE mode. The API paths used by this tab (/v1/manual-review, /v1/templatestorelist, /v1/templatestore/render) are registered for function OCMS_OIC_FURNISH (api-authorization.properties:76-85); the server-side role check was not read. The same tab also opens for a Reject decision, not only Approve.

steps.step: Officer picks the mode (Email or SMS) and the recipient (Owner/Hirer/Driver) for the notification
steps.detail: The Message Mode dropdown (Email/SMS) is in ReplyComposeForm.tsx:93-110 and immediately fills emailTo or mobileCode/mobileNo from the furnished data (lines 102-103). The Recipients dropdown (Owner/Hirer/Driver) in ComposeEditor.tsx:211-266 fills the address from the owner (O) or from the furnished hirer/driver (D/H) only when the chosen role equals the submission's ownerDriverIndicator; otherwise the field is cleared for manual entry (lines 231-243). The Owner recipient is available too, which goes beyond the story that names the furnished hirer/driver.

steps.step: OCMS populates a standard template for the officer's selection (decision, recipient, mode)
steps.detail: The Template dropdown loads its list through POST templatestorelist (templateName regex FURNISH_, SelectTemplate.tsx:78-100), then filters by decision status, mode and recipient (ALLOWED_TEMPLATES, lines 31-64 and 110-117; for Approve for example FURNISH_SMS_OWNER/DRIVER/HIRER and FURNISH_EMAIL_APPROVAL/DRIVER/HIRER). When a template is picked the UI calls POST templatestore/render (lines 119-174); the backend reads the template, VON, ONOD and furnish application and replaces placeholders (OcmsTemplateStoreServiceImpl.java:62-114), and the UI replaces {{driverName}}, {{hirerName}}, {{ownerName}}, {{officerName}} (lines 146-151). Template content is a DB row in ocms_template_store that is not seeded in the repo, so the presence of FURNISH_* rows in PRD cannot be verified from the repo. History: OCMS-DF-2026-136 (Closed, Prod deployed) the Reply dropdown was empty because the ALLOWED_TEMPLATES map was incomplete, the map now has Approve and Reject entries; OCMS-DF-2026-004 (Closed) shows another template row (FURNISH_EMAIL_OFFICER_DAILY) was once not loaded in PRD.

steps.step: The populated template content can be amended by the officer in a free-text field
steps.detail: The render result is written into form.subject and form.message (SelectTemplate.tsx:153-157) and stays editable: Subject TextInput (ComposeEditor.tsx:306-316), rich-text EditorInput for the email body with maxLength 4000 (lines 319-351), and SMS TextAreaInput (lines 357-363). Read-only only when the disabled prop is set (default false, SelectTemplate.tsx:67). Side effect: changing decision status, recipient or approve-as resets the template and message text (SelectTemplate.tsx:182-198), so the officer's edits are lost when the choice changes. The backend uses the request text as is without re-rendering (ManualReviewController.java:368-376).

steps.step: The customised email and/or SMS is delivered to the furnished hirer/driver
steps.detail: Compose entries are added to compose_list (ReplyComposeForm.tsx:57-90). On Submit each entry is sent on its own: SMS is batched to POST manual-review/send-sms, emails one by one to send-email (useFurnishAPI.ts:148-192). The backend sends straight away through EmailService or smsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple and records it in the notification tables with service_type FURNISH, status S or E (FurnishNotificationService.java:50-98, 166-222). Gap 1: the UI sends emailCC (FurnishMap.ts:59) but the EmailRequest DTO has no CC field (ManualReviewController.java:688-695), so CC is silently dropped. Gap 2: when the checkbox is ticked but compose_list is empty, no message is sent and no warning is shown (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:215-216). Real delivery over SMTP and the SMS APIM cannot be verified from the repo; flags email.enableSmtp=true (application.properties:133) and sms.enable=true (application-prod.properties:36), the real server values cannot be verified from the repo.
